card.name: The word to after reported
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "reported" (e.g. "has been reported to") in drug interaction and adverse effect statements. Also seen after a few other verbs like "respond" or "came".

modes.label: Reported to
modes.description: "to" following "has/have been reported", leading into an effect on the body or another drug.
modes.example: has been reported<< to>> result in an increase in abnormal mammograms

modes.label: Other verb plus to
modes.description: "to" after verbs like respond or came, in general or label text.
modes.example: not respond<< to>>, or cannot tolerate, other antih

card.writes: Suppresses words about continuation, with no clear positive effect; little meaningful output effect.
card.plain: It marks the little word "to" in phrases like "has been reported to cause" in drug labels.
